computation_basis.close_lookup: the close standing for a date is the last positive stored close on or before it, at most 7 calendar days older
computation_basis.currency_note: the rule detects a window in the crash benchmark's own currency; every list, the benchmark's return beside it included, is in EUR
computation_basis.dates: the rule's: start is the last day at the peak, trough the earliest lowest close before the recovery; a name never moves them
computation_basis.days_back: calendar days from a security's own low to its first close at or above its close standing for the window's start, compared in the display basis in its own currency; 0 when the low is not below that close; null with not_yet when no close up to today reaches it
computation_basis.figure: each security's EUR price return from the window's start to its trough by WindowReturn.price_return/3, the function sale hindsight and the prediction resolution share; lowest first; a price return: distributions are not counted
computation_basis.fx: each close converts at the stored EUR-hub rate of its own date, carried forward without a bound, never a later one; the return is one division of exact products
computation_basis.gaps: a day without a close is skipped, never interpolated; a security with no close standing for the start is no_close_at_start, none standing for the end no_close_at_end (none within 7 days, or a security younger than the window), a close without a stored rate path to EUR no_fx_rate; each is counted under its reason and never ranked as a zero
computation_basis.input_series: each security's stored closes in the current display basis (ADR-0028 §2), positive closes only, each converted to EUR at the most recent stored EUR-hub rate on or before the close's own date
computation_basis.provisional: a window not yet recovered is provisional, its trough the lowest close so far; its lists move with it and carry the flag
computation_basis.recovery_span: rebounders are measured to the trough plus 3 calendar months, one span for every window; a day the month lacks becomes its last day; while the span has not ended the list is measured to today, provisional, and names the day it completes
computation_basis.reference: the crash benchmark measured by the same rule and function as each entry: over the same dates for losers and winners, from its own low for rebounders; vs_benchmark_pp is (return - benchmark_return) x 100, in percentage points, unrounded
computation_basis.split_adjustment: both closes in the current display basis: a booked split divides the raw closes before its effective date, so a split inside the window is not a move
computation_basis.survivorship: the catalogue holds what is still tracked: a security that failed and was removed is in no list, so the lists read better than the market did, and a rebound most of all
computation_basis.ties: equal figures are ordered by the security's name, case-folded, then by its ISIN, its ticker, its WKN and its currency (a security without one after those with one); entries equal on all of these share a rank and are ordered among themselves by the security's creation time; an id decides no rank
computation_basis.universe: catalogue: every security the catalogue holds, not merged away, minus those flagged is_benchmark (reference instruments) and the crash benchmark itself
